name: James Morrison
discretionary_target: Note the approaching refund window deadline

turns.text: Hello, I have a question about a return.
Sure, my customer ID is CUST-002.
Wait, the deadline is approaching? I wasn't aware there was a time limit on this. How much time do I have left?
Okay, so what do I need to do to actually start the return process?
Got it, I'll get that done right away. Thanks for the information.
